acceptanceCriteria: A decision record accepts or rejects the declared-sibling shape with reasons.
If accepted, a spec slice with numbered requirements is filed; if rejected, PRODUCT.md states the recommended workaround.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner-requested gap analysis of Corvint against competing context tools, current standards and a trial on a local clone of MeVille (TypeScript, about 4,600 tracked files). Cross-repository federation is a stated non-goal of the local profile (docs/PRODUCT.md). Multi-repo and service-boundary context is a leading user complaint and a feature of Augment, Sourcegraph, Qodo and Copilot Spaces. A constraint-compatible shape exists: a repository-owned declaration of sibling repositories pinned by commit, read only from local clones, returning an explicit unknown when a clone is absent or at another commit. The owner needs to decide whether that shape breaches the non-goal.
title: multi-repo: decide whether declared, commit-pinned sibling repositories are admissible evidence
